decisions.reason: As a large incumbent in a growing machinery market, the firm is likely to keep this core-adjacent coolant system because it fits existing capabilities and there is no clear sign of performance below aspiration levels.

This centrifuge extends the established coolant-management offer, so with organizational slack and no evidence of underperformance management would likely continue it rather than reallocate resources.
Although a multi-model product line can create some complexity, the nozzles are tightly linked to the firm's installed base and modular systems, making retention more likely than withdrawal.

Because this chip conveyor is only close to rather than fully within the established offer, its fit is slightly weaker, but the firm's broad portfolio and search for automation solutions still favor keeping it.
This product builds directly on the firm's existing chip-conveyor and process-support business, so absent negative feedback it would likely satisfy aspirations enough to remain on the market.

This hinged belt chip conveyor is near the firm's core business and likely benefits from shared production and sales channels, so a large German engineering firm would usually keep it unless results clearly disappointed.
